notes.title: SpikerMan X 1.02 Update!
notes.content:
​Hey Folks!

It's been about a week since the release of SpikerMan X and I've been working on some updates. I've learned a lot from the release and I wanted to share some new features the game has.

The biggest addition to the game is there's new difficulty settings! You can now play the game on Normal mode or Hard mode. Some people told me they found the game too easy, so I was working on making things a little more challenging. I was able to beat Hard mode last night so I hope you all enjoy the changes!

Had a lot of bug fixes and re-balancing to some bosses. They're documented more in the devlog in the main menu, and also wanted to mention that the game does support controllers if you're having trouble with the keyboard buttons.

Thanks for you're feedback and I'll continue working on the game!
